That matches the start of this row, which begins at Dominion LNG in Maryland. The order says the pipeline belongs to Dominion Energy Cove Point LNG, so check that this row covers that company's line and not only the Dominion Transmission lines. Accepting adds the name to the other English names cell and changes nothing else. The 2008 Cove Point expansion loop is queued separately. The other English names column has no reference column, so the order is listed here as the source.
